summary.text: Amy Wright is the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 91 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Bob Peterson.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as counselor.

paragraphs.text: Wright graduated from Miami Trace High School and earned an associate degree from Southern State Community College in 2007, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mental health counselor with 20 years in public service and the helping professions.
She said her priorities include fully funding public schools rather than programs such as EdChoice, expanding affordable housing, and strengthening child care infrastructure.
